description: Open limit / stop orders resting in the Cookiebox limit-order escrow for a wallet (yours by default, or `owner` = any address or .cook name). Read straight from the chain via the Cookiebox aggregator — no key needed. Each order shows the remaining input, the gross output the program enforces (`minReceive`), what the wallet actually receives after the maker fee (`netAfterFee`), the price (a stop's TRIGGER), fill progress, expiry and status (`open` / `filling` / `expired` — an expired order still holds its input until it is cancelled). `fees` is the live on-chain schedule in bps (null when unavailable). MomoSwap curve orders placed on cookiebox.app appear too: `kind: 'curve-buy'` is an escrow order that pays out as curve shares, `kind: 'curve-sell'` is a launchpad sale authorization — `escrowed: false`, the shares stay spendable; cancel_limit_order revokes it.

owner.description: wallet address or .cook name; defaults to the configured wallet
